description: Was an RFWIN prize draw fair. Recomputes the draw server-side: SHA-256 seed commitment, entry-list hash, the drand public randomness round (cross-checked against the drand network), draw digest, every win hash, and re-derives every winner from the entry list. Returns verdict (verified | verified_hash_level | partially_verified | mismatch | not_drawn_yet), each check with details, what verification does and does not prove, the hashes and a recipe to recompute it yourself. Free, no key.

draw.description: RFWIN proof link (e.g. https://rfwin.uk/d/xxlqh5ac9f) or the draw id
